verdict.rationale: AiPrise is a compliance and verification SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or endpoint. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes and the verification APIs are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
